_meta.purpose: Stage 1.3 REM typing eval — ground truth for entity sub-type + typed-relationship assignment.
_meta.ground_truth: human judgment (curated from real corpus entities). Ensemble agreement is a FILTER not truth; disagreements get human adjudication (decision 475). Minority classes Model/Document are smaller — macro-F1 noise expected.
_meta.fallback_label: OTHER = no confident sub-type (maps to untyped :Entity / MENTIONS).
_meta.rel_none: NONE = no valid typed relationship (maps to MENTIONS fallback).
_meta.depends_on_vs_consumes: Litmus (advisor-agent rule): swap the target for a functional equivalent — if the source would get DIFFERENT data (models, embedders, APIs whose identity shapes output) use CONSUMES; if it would get the same result (databases, locks, libraries, plain components — transparent vessels) use DEPENDS_ON.
